notes: The first waw of the lowland clause was given the postposed 'also' under rule 51 and the second waw the written 'and'.
'fruitful fields' was headed on 'fruitful' by rule 31's subtraction; heading on 'fields' was the competing reading.
The supplied 'and he had' is added: that clause writes no hayah, no possessive preposition and no suffix, so nothing in it makes it possessive (rule 43).
In the first possessive clause the written hayah takes 'had', its lamed goes unrepresented and the suffix takes the subject pronoun (rules 40, 43).
